::: {.takeaways}
1. **Copying the teacher's answers is enough.** Supervised fine-tuning on the 2B's own answers (B)
   takes the 0.8B from `{python} h["before"]` to `{python} h["after"]` exact match, past the
   teacher's `{python} h["teacher"]` and `{python} h["share_of_a"]` of what training on gold labels gains.
2. **Three kinds of distillation tie.** Matching the teacher's probabilities (C) and learning on the
   student's own answers (D) land within `{python} f"{100 * tie_gap:.1f}"` points of B. They differ in cost, and on tools the student
   never saw.
3. **Labels still buy a lot**: the same recipe on gold answers reaches `{python} h["with_labels"]`.
4. **The student serves `{python} serve["one_at_a_time"]` faster** than its teacher, one request at a time.
:::
